name: Tianjie Sun
persona: Integration-platform engineer for the agent era.
persona_zh: 做集成平台的工程师，正在把它搬到 agent 时代。
lede: I build the integration layer between recruiting software and the world's applicant-tracking systems — and I'm working out what that layer should look like when the clients are AI agents, not people clicking buttons.
lede_zh: 我做的是招聘软件和各家 ATS 之间的集成层；现在在想的问题是：当调用方从点按钮的人变成 AI agent，这一层该长成什么样。
now: Tech lead of the ATS integration platform at hireEZ: one platform, ~58 ATS / CRM / HCM vendors, a 3-engineer squad.
Running tianjie.me as a weekly, agent-assisted publishing pipeline — one research-backed interactive page every Saturday.
Building toward Senior/Staff-level roles on platform, integration and agent infrastructure teams in the Bay Area.
now_zh: hireEZ ATS 集成平台 tech lead：一个平台，约 58 家 ATS / CRM / HCM 厂商，三人小队。
把 tianjie.me 当成一条每周运转的、agent 辅助的出版流水线：每周六一个有出处的交互页面。
朝着湾区平台 / 集成 / agent 基础设施方向的 Senior / Staff 岗位准备。

facts.v: Senior Software Engineer, hireEZ (Apr 2021 – present); tech lead of the ATS-Squad
